14: # Video Generation (HeyGen API)
15: 
16: Generate AI videos from text prompts. Supports multiple providers (VEO 3.1, Kling, Sora, Runway, Seedance), configurable aspect ratios, and optional reference images for image-to-video generation.
17: 
18: ## Authentication
19: 
20: All requests require the `X-Api-Key` header. Set the `HEYGEN_API_KEY` environment variable.
21: 
22: ```bash
23: curl -X POST "https://api.heygen.com/v1/workflows/executions" \
24:   -H "X-Api-Key: $HEYGEN_API_KEY" \
25:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
26:   -d '{"workflow_type": "GenerateVideoNode", "input": {"prompt": "A drone shot flying over a coastal city at sunset"}}'
27: ```
28: 
29: ## Default Workflow
30: 
31: 1. Call `POST /v1/workflows/executions` with `workflow_type: "GenerateVideoNode"` and your prompt
32: 2. Receive a `execution_id` in the response
33: 3. Poll `GET /v1/workflows/executions/{id}` every 10 seconds until status is `completed`
34: 4. Use the returned `video_url` from the output
35: 
36: ## Execute Video Generation
37: 
38: ### Endpoint
39: 
40: `POST https://api.heygen.com/v1/workflows/executions`
41: 
42: ### Request Fields
43: 
44: | Field | Type | Req | Description |
45: |-------|------|:---:|-------------|
46: | `workflow_type` | string | Y | Must be `"GenerateVideoNode"` |
47: | `input.prompt` | string | Y | Text description of the video to generate |
48: | `input.provider` | string | | Video generation provider (default: `"veo_3_1"`). See Providers below. |
49: | `input.aspect_ratio` | string | | Aspect ratio (default: `"16:9"`). Common values: `"16:9"`, `"9:16"`, `"1:1"` |
50: | `input.reference_image_url` | string | | Reference image URL for image-to-video generation |
51: | `input.tail_image_url` | string | | Tail image URL for last-frame guidance |
52: | `input.config` | object | | Provider-specific configuration overrides |
53: 
54: ### Providers
55: 
56: | Provider | Value | Description |
57: |----------|-------|-------------|
58: | VEO 3.1 | `"veo_3_1"` | Google VEO 3.1 (default, highest quality) |
59: | VEO 3.1 Fast | `"veo_3_1_fast"` | Faster VEO 3.1 variant |
60: | VEO 3 | `"veo3"` | Google VEO 3 |
61: | VEO 3 Fast | `"veo3_fast"` | Faster VEO 3 variant |
62: | VEO 2 | `"veo2"` | Google VEO 2 |
63: | Kling Pro | `"kling_pro"` | Kling Pro model |
64: | Kling V2 | `"kling_v2"` | Kling V2 model |
65: | Sora V2 | `"sora_v2"` | OpenAI Sora V2 |
66: | Sora V2 Pro | `"sora_v2_pro"` | OpenAI Sora V2 Pro |
67: | Runway Gen-4 | `"runway_gen4"` | Runway Gen-4 |
68: | Seedance Lite | `"seedance_lite"` | Seedance Lite |
69: | Seedance Pro | `"seedance_pro"` | Seedance Pro |
70: | LTX Distilled | `"ltx_distilled"` | LTX Distilled (fastest) |

72: ### curl

74: ```bash
75: curl -X POST "https://api.heygen.com/v1/workflows/executions" \
76:   -H "X-Api-Key: $HEYGEN_API_KEY" \

83:       "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
84:     }

86: ```

88: ### TypeScript
89: 
90: ```typescript

92:   prompt: string;
93:   provider?: string;
94:   aspect_ratio?: string;
95:   reference_image_url?: string;
96:   tail_image_url?: string;
97:   config?: Record<string, any>;
98: }
99: 
100: interface ExecuteResponse {

104:   };
105: }
106: 
107: async function generateVideo(input: GenerateVideoInput): Promise<string> {
108:   const response = await fetch("https://api.heygen.com/v1/workflows/executions", {
109:     method: "POST",
110:     headers: {
111:       "X-Api-Key": process.env.HEYGEN_API_KEY!,
112:       "Content-Type": "application/json",
113:     },
114:     body: JSON.stringify({
115:       workflow_type: "GenerateVideoNode",
116:       input,
117:     }),
118:   });
119: 
120:   const json: ExecuteResponse = await response.json();
121:   return json.data.execution_id;
122: }
123: ```

125: ### Python

128: import requests
129: import os
130: 
131: def generate_video(
132:     prompt: str,
133:     provider: str = "veo_3_1",
134:     aspect_ratio: str = "16:9",
135:     reference_image_url: str | None = None,
136:     tail_image_url: str | None = None,
137: ) -> str:
138:     payload = {
139:         "workflow_type": "GenerateVideoNode",
140:         "input": {
141:             "prompt": prompt,
142:             "provider": provider,
143:             "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
144:         },
145:     }
146: 
147:     if reference_image_url:
148:         payload["input"]["reference_image_url"] = reference_image_url
149:     if tail_image_url:
150:         payload["input"]["tail_image_url"] = tail_image_url
151: 
152:     response = requests.post(
153:         "https://api.heygen.com/v1/workflows/executions",
154:         headers={
155:             "X-Api-Key": os.environ["HEYGEN_API_KEY"],
156:             "Content-Type": "application/json",
157:         },
158:         json=payload,
159:     )
160: 
161:     data = response.json()
162:     return data["data"]["execution_id"]
163: ```

207: ## Polling for Completion
208: 
209: ```typescript
210: async function generateVideoAndWait(
211:   input: GenerateVideoInput,
212:   maxWaitMs = 600000,
213:   pollIntervalMs = 10000
214: ): Promise<{ video_url: string; video_id: string; asset_id: string }> {
215:   const executionId = await generateVideo(input);
216:   console.log(`Submitted video generation: ${executionId}`);
217: 
218:   const startTime = Date.now();
219:   while (Date.now() - startTime < maxWaitMs) {
220:     const response = await fetch(
221:       `https://api.heygen.com/v1/workflows/executions/${executionId}`,
222:       { headers: { "X-Api-Key": process.env.HEYGEN_API_KEY! } }
223:     );
224:     const { data } = await response.json();
225: 
226:     switch (data.status) {
227:       case "completed":
228:         return {
229:           video_url: data.output.video.video_url,
230:           video_id: data.output.video.video_id,
231:           asset_id: data.output.asset_id,
232:         };
233:       case "failed":
234:         throw new Error(data.error?.message || "Video generation failed");
235:       case "not_found":
236:         throw new Error("Workflow not found");
237:       default:
238:         await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, pollIntervalMs));
239:     }
240:   }
241: 
242:   throw new Error("Video generation timed out");
243: }
244: ```

300: ## Best Practices
301:
